title: Jailer 2's Hindi Version Enters Top Five Dubbed Tamil Grossers in Four Days
excerpt: Rajini The Jailer 2 reached an estimated Rs 16.65 crore Hindi net in four days, more than double the first Jailer's full Hindi run, as the film crossed Rs 425 crore worldwide.
body:
• The Hindi-dubbed version of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2, titled Rajini The Jailer 2, reached an estimated Rs 16.65 crore net in India in four days, according to Sacnilk.
  • That total makes it the fifth-highest-grossing Hindi-dubbed Tamil film of all time, behind 2.0, Leo, Ponniyin Selvan 1 and Jana Nayagan, according to Koimoi.
  • The Hindi version has already more than doubled the Rs 7.2 crore lifetime Hindi net of the first Jailer.
  • Worldwide, the film crossed an estimated Rs 425 crore gross in four days, Koimoi reported.

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has added a Hindi-market milestone to its opening weekend. The dubbed version, released as Rajini The Jailer 2, collected an estimated Rs 5.5 crore to Rs 6 crore net on Sunday, its fourth day, taking its Hindi net total in India to about Rs 16.65 crore, according to Koimoi and figures tracked by Sacnilk.

A Top-Five Finish in Four Days

Sacnilk's day-wise Hindi figures put the run at Rs 3.50 crore on day one, Rs 2.90 crore on day two, Rs 4.50 crore on day three and Rs 5.75 crore on day four, for a four-day net of Rs 16.65 crore. On Koimoi's all-time list for Tamil films dubbed in Hindi, that places Jailer 2 fifth, edging past The Greatest Of All Time at Rs 16.60 crore and Ponniyin Selvan 2 at Rs 16.24 crore. Ahead of it remain 2.0 at Rs 188 crore, Leo at Rs 27.17 crore, Ponniyin Selvan 1 at Rs 22.91 crore and Jana Nayagan at Rs 17.10 crore.

"On Koimoi's all-time list for Tamil films dubbed in Hindi, that places Jailer 2 fifth, edging past The Greatest Of All Time at Rs 16.60 crore and Ponniyin Selvan 2 at Rs 16.24 crore."

The comparison with the first film is stark. Koimoi noted that the original Jailer finished its entire Hindi run at Rs 7.2 crore net. The sequel passed that figure before its opening weekend ended.

The Wider Picture

The Hindi result sits inside a much larger opening. Koimoi estimated the film's worldwide gross at Rs 425 crore to Rs 426 crore after four days, making it, on those estimates, the fifth Indian film of 2026 to cross Rs 400 crore worldwide and the highest-grossing Tamil film of the year so far. Our earlier coverage tracked the same trajectory: the film crossed Rs 300 crore worldwide on day three.

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, Jailer 2 sees Rajinikanth return as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, with Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, SJ Suryah and Vidya Balan among the cast named in weekend coverage.

What to Watch Next

The test now is the first weekday. Koimoi argued that a steady Monday in North Indian single screens could put Ponniyin Selvan 1 and Leo within reach on the Hindi-dubbed list. The gap to Jana Nayagan in fourth place is less than Rs 50 lakh on the figures reported so far. Day-four numbers are early-trend estimates and may be revised as final collections are reported.
